name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Embossed Acrylic Ornament
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 1 layer of 3mm transparent acrylic, providing a lightweight, durable, and crystal-clear base for personalized ornament designs.
    - Features a clear glossy acrylic surface with raised embossed contour lines, creating a handcrafted stained-glass-inspired appearance.
    - Raised line details add noticeable texture, depth, and dimension to the printed artwork while maintaining the transparency of the acrylic.
    - Custom-cut construction allows the ornament to follow unique silhouettes and detailed decorative shapes.
    - Comes with included hanging accessories for easy display.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in sizes:
             +) 3.5 x 3.5 in ~ 8.89 x 8.89 cm
             +) 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm
             +) 5 x 5 in ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Artwork is printed directly onto clear transparent acrylic by UV printing, producing colorful and detailed personalized designs while preserving a translucent appearance.
    - Features raised contour line effects on the glossy acrylic surface to emphasize outlines and decorative details.
    - The embossed line effect adds tactile texture and visual depth, helping create the appearance of handcrafted stained glass.
    - Precision cutting is used to create clean custom silhouettes and detailed openings within the ornament design.
    📌 Please Note: Raised line effects on flat surfaces will only be applied when the required raised-line elements are included in the customer’s artwork file.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a personalized hanging ornament for Christmas trees, memorial displays, room décor, window decoration, and seasonal displays.
    - Transparent acrylic allows light to interact with the printed artwork, enhancing the stained-glass-inspired visual effect.
    - Raised embossed outlines provide additional texture and make decorative details stand out more prominently.
    - Suitable for customization with names, dates, meaningful messages, pets, family themes, memorial artwork, and other personalized designs.
    - Lightweight yet durable for convenient hanging and long-lasting decorative use.
    - Easy to display with the included hanging accessories.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, pet owners, friends, couples, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Christmas, pet memorials, remembrance gifts, anniversaries, family celebrations, and other special occasions.
    - Ideal for commemorating a beloved pet or loved one with personalized names, dates, illustrations, and meaningful details.
    - Great for creating unique stained-glass-inspired keepsakes with custom artwork and dimensional raised outlines.
    - A beautiful decorative keepsake designed to preserve special memories in a distinctive personalized form.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Embossed Acrylic Ornament

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
